title: Vanilla with Sprinkles
description: A lightweight Minecraft modpack focused on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and enhanced visuals. Designed to preserve the vanilla experience while making the game cleaner.
body: A lightweight Minecraft modpack focused on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and enhanced visuals. Designed to preserve the vanilla experience while making the game smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable—perfect for everyday play or long-term worlds.
